stable.notes: The Session Pet's live list is now mission rows, built to orchestrate a fleet of agents at a glance. One list, three weights: RUNNING rows carry a green rail, a two-line title, a pulsing mono LIVE line saying what the agent is doing right now, its workspace, and a compact colored age. WAITING ON YOU is its own amber section that names what each session waits on — a raw permission wait reads as 'needs you'. Idle sessions recede to dim one-liners. The LIVE line renders the per-session activity summary the server has always shipped and the pet never displayed. The whole row still jumps to the session, the drop x and restore controls are unchanged, and the list's scroll frame grew to fit the richer rows. Everything in 0.5.154 — the Jedi walking loops, Nia's meditation, the ledger chrome, completion chips, terminal jump — is unchanged. Pairs with server 6.41.0.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
